title: Make Hero stats clickable to show 1–1000 and remove 24/7 stat

requirements.text: Update the Home page Hero stats in `frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSection.tsx` so that clicking the "Years Experience" stat and the "Happy Clients" stat opens a modal/dialog that displays the numbers 1 through 1000 (inclusive) in a scrollable list.

quotes: if i click happy clint and 10+years experience it need to open and show 1 to 1000

acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page Hero section, both the "Years Experience" and "Happy Clients" stat blocks are clickable/tappable.
Clicking either stat opens a modal/dialog without navigating away from the page.
The opened modal shows a visible list of numbers from 1 to 1000 inclusive.
The list is scrollable and does not overflow the viewport on mobile or desktop.
The modal can be closed via an explicit close control and by pressing Escape (if using the existing dialog/modal patterns).
All user-facing text added for this feature is in English.

requirements.text: Remove the "24/7" stat ("24/7" + "Support Available") from the Hero stats area in `frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSection.tsx`, and ensure the stats layout remains responsive and visually balanced after removal.
acceptanceCriteria: The Hero section no longer displays "24/7" or "Support Available" anywhere in the stats row/grid.
The stats grid remains responsive across breakpoints (no broken spacing/alignment after removing the third item).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and anything under `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Keep changes limited to implementing the requested Hero stat click behavior and removing the "24/7" stat; do not alter unrelated content or backend APIs.
nonGoals: Do not add or change backend data models/APIs for this feature.
Do not change the existing hero heading/subheading content loading behavior from site content.
